command:
$ErrorActionPreference="Stop"
$repo=$env:FLYEXPLORER_CANONICAL_CHECKOUT
Set-Location -LiteralPath $repo
$script=Join-Path $repo "logs\pictures-canonical-diagnosis.py"
@'
import ctypes as c
from ctypes import wintypes as W
shell32=c.WinDLL("shell32")
ole32=c.WinDLL("ole32")
pidl=c.c_void_p()
attrs=W.DWORD()
shell32.SHParseDisplayName.argtypes=[W.LPCWSTR,c.c_void_p,c.POINTER(c.c_void_p),W.DWORD,c.POINTER(W.DWORD)]
shell32.SHParseDisplayName.restype=W.LONG
hr=shell32.SHParseDisplayName("shell:PicturesLibrary",None,c.byref(pidl),0,c.byref(attrs))
if hr<0 or not pidl.value: raise SystemExit(f"SHParseDisplayName failed {hr}")
name=c.c_wchar_p()
shell32.SHGetNameFromIDList.argtypes=[c.c_void_p,c.c_int,c.POINTER(c.c_wchar_p)]
shell32.SHGetNameFromIDList.restype=W.LONG
hr=shell32.SHGetNameFromIDList(pidl,0x80028000,c.byref(name))
if hr<0 or not name.value: raise SystemExit(f"SHGetNameFromIDList failed {hr}")
print("PICTURES_LIBRARY_CANONICAL",repr(name.value),flush=True)
ole32.CoTaskMemFree(name)
ole32.CoTaskMemFree(pidl)
'@ | Set-Content -LiteralPath $script -Encoding UTF8
try { & python -X utf8 $script; if($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0){throw "canonical diagnosis failed"} } finally { Remove-Item -LiteralPath $script -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue }
Write-Host "PICTURES_LIBRARY_CANONICAL_DIAGNOSIS=PASS"
